chapters.title: Matter in Our Surroundings
chapters.description: Physical nature of matter, characteristics of particles, states of matter (solid, liquid, gas), change of state (melting, boiling, sublimation, evaporation), and latent heat.

levels.title: Physical Nature & States of Matter
levels.description: Particles of matter and distinguishing solid, liquid, gas by shape, volume, compressibility.

levels.description: Surface phenomenon of evaporation, cooling effect, and factors: temperature, surface area, humidity, wind speed.
subtopics: Cooling caused by evaporation in earthen pots & sweating

levels.title: Chapter 1 Review & NCERT Activities
levels.description: Review of matter concepts and conceptual reasoning.

chapters.title: Is Matter Around Us Pure?
chapters.description: Mixtures, solutions, suspensions, colloids, Tyndall effect, physical and chemical changes, elements, and compounds.

levels.title: Solutions, Suspensions & Colloids
levels.description: True solutions (solute + solvent), concentration of a solution (mass percentage), suspensions, colloids, and Tyndall effect.

levels.title: Physical vs Chemical Changes & Compounds
levels.description: Distinction between physical and chemical changes; properties of elements vs compounds.

levels.title: Chapter 2 Review & Purity of Matter
levels.description: Review of mixtures and solutions with numerical concentrations.

chapters.title: The Fundamental Unit of Life
chapters.description: Cell as basic unit of life, plasma membrane, diffusion, osmosis, cell wall, nucleus, cytoplasm, and cell organelles.

levels.title: Cell Structure, Membrane & Osmosis
levels.description: Plasma membrane structure, diffusion of gases, osmosis in hypotonic, isotonic, and hypertonic solutions.

levels.title: Nucleus, Chromosomes & Organelles
levels.description: Nuclear membrane, chromatin, DNA & genes; functions of ER, Golgi apparatus, lysosomes, mitochondria, and plastids.

levels.title: Chapter 5 Review & Cytology Diagrams
levels.description: Review of cell biology with comparative diagram analysis.
